User.title: User
User.description: Authenticated KINETIC FORM user profile with persistent goal, training/diet environment preferences, water log, and consistency streak dates.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the navigation bar.

onboarded.description: Whether the user has completed initial preference selection.

waterCupsToday.description: Number of water cups checked off for lastWaterDate.

lastWaterDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD for the active water intake counter.

completedDates.description: List of recent YYYY-MM-DD dates marked complete for weekly consistency tracking.

createdAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when account was created.

updatedAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when profile was last updated.

Workout.title: Workout
Workout.description: Guided or custom workout routine belonging to a single user.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this workout record.

templateKey.description: Optional identifier linking to a built-in guided split routine (empty string for custom workouts).

dayLabel.description: Schedule label such as Day 01 · Monday.

exercises.description: Ordered list of exercises with sets, reps, rest seconds, cues, and alternatives.

completedExerciseIds.description: Exercise IDs checked off in the current session.

isCompleted.description: Whether the workout session is marked completed.

isCustom.description: True if user-created custom workout; false if tracked state for a guided split.

lastCompletedDate.description: Most recent YYYY-MM-DD completion date or empty string.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in Unix epoch ms.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in Unix epoch ms.

Meal.title: Meal
Meal.description: Tracked guided meal completion or user-created custom meal entry belonging to a single user.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this meal entry.

templateKey.description: Optional identifier linking to a built-in diet template (empty string for custom meals).

prepNotes.description: Prep instructions or smart-swap ordering guidance.

checkedDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD date when this meal was last checked off, or empty string.

isCustom.description: True if user-created custom meal; false if tracked state for a guided meal.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in Unix epoch ms.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in Unix epoch ms.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Elevated administrator access record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user fitness profile, active environment toggles, water counter, and weekly streak log.

/workouts/{workoutId}.description: Owner-scoped guided session progress and custom workout routines.

/meals/{mealId}.description: Owner-scoped guided meal check-offs and custom meal plans.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Read-only admin roster managed via Firebase Console.
